- Lesions concentrated along leaf margins
- Brown/tan centers with darker brown borders
- Some lesions have yellowish halos
- Multiple discrete spots scattered along the leaf

Top candidates: Eyespot, Physoderma_brown_spot, Holcus_spot, Carbonum_leaf_spot. Let me view reference images.

- **Physoderma_brown_spot**: Reddish streaks along midrib - not matching
- **Holcus_spot**: Irregular tan/brown lesions, some oval - partial match
- **Carbonum_leaf_spot**: Oval/elliptical lesions with dark brown borders, tan centers, zonate pattern - good match
- **Northern_corn_leaf_blight**: Large cigar-shaped gray lesions - not matching
- **Anthracnose_leaf_spot**: Dark oval spots with yellow halos - partial match

The test image shows discrete oval/elliptical lesions with dark brown borders and lighter tan/brown centers, scattered along the leaf margin. The lesion shape, size, border contrast, and scattered pattern most closely match **Carbonum_leaf_spot**, which produces oval lesions with distinct dark borders and lighter centers across the leaf surface.
